topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The note slid under my door, voice as slick and evasive as the streets on a downpour night. "Surprise Party: Forget it." Just the date and the cryptic message, no signature or clues. I traced the edge of the paper, smooth and definitively there. Must've missed a turn somewhere, thought I knew the angles, the players. The shape of plans shifting like shadows on cracked pavement. Thought I'd timed it right, picked up on the whispers and chuckles. But this? Not in the script. Thing is, when the world gives you a curveball, you either duck or take the hit. Time to retrace steps, find out who shuffled the deck.
